tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Brand and interaction fill: primary buttons, the selected segment, focus, links drawn as fills, the one hero slab per screen. White (`on-cobalt`) text on it is 5.2:1. Never a page background, never decoration.

tokens.name: cobalt-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of every `cobalt` fill. White text on it is 8.6:1.

tokens.name: cobalt-text
tokens.usage: Cobalt as text or icon: inline links, 'See all', active tab labels. Reads on `surface`, `chalk` and `cobalt-tint` in both themes (≥5.3:1).

tokens.name: cobalt-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the active filter chip, info banners. Pair with `cobalt-text`.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `cobalt` and `cobalt-press` only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on `chalk`, `surface`, `surface-sunk` (≥15:1 light, ≥13:1 dark). Also the stroke of hairline-ruled structures in poster moments.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: card metadata, bios, descriptions. On `surface` and `chalk` ≥7.9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholders, captions, inactive icons, checkbox outlines. On `surface` and `chalk` ≥4.5:1 in both themes; never on `surface-sunk` for text under 15px.

tokens.name: chalk
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen. Content cards sit on it as `surface` without shadows.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, lists, sheets, the ticket body. Separation from `chalk` comes from the value step, not a border or shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Inputs, progress tracks, inactive icon wells, skeleton blocks, the hashtag tab of an unstarted task.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline (1px) dividers between list rows and inside switchboards. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: outline buttons, the dashed ticket perforation, unchecked controls (≥3:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The always-dark layer: navigation capsule, toasts, ticket stubs, the active day in date strips. Stays dark in both themes; in dark it lifts one step above `surface` so it still floats.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text and active icons on `night` (≥13:1).

tokens.name: on-night-2
tokens.usage: Inactive icons and secondary text on `night` (≥5.6:1).

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: Signal accent, reserved for karma and 'now': karma gains, the live dot, progress fill on `night` and `cobalt`, the slide-to-confirm thumb, rank #1. At most one volt object per screen region. Text on it is `on-volt`.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `volt` (15:1).

tokens.name: volt-text
tokens.usage: Karma numbers and gains set as text on `surface` or `chalk` (6.6:1 light, 14:1 dark).

tokens.name: ig-coder
tokens.usage: Sticker fill for Interest Groups in the 'coder' category (Web Development, DSA, Devops, AI…). Printed-matter colour: identical in both themes, always with `ink-print` text.

tokens.name: ig-maker
tokens.usage: Sticker fill for 'maker' IGs (IoT and Robotics, Blender, Space, Civil). Always `ink-print` text.

tokens.name: ig-creative
tokens.usage: Sticker fill for 'creative' IGs (UI/UX, Comics, Creative Design). Always `ink-print` text.

tokens.name: ig-manager
tokens.usage: Sticker fill for 'manager' IGs (Project Management, Human Resources, Strategic Leadership). Always `ink-print` text.

tokens.name: ig-others
tokens.usage: Sticker fill for 'others' IGs and any IG whose category is unknown. Always `ink-print` text.

tokens.name: ink-print
tokens.usage: Text on printed-matter fills (IG stickers, `volt`) that keep their colour across themes. ≥8:1 on every `ig-*` fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons: approved, verified, task accepted. Always paired with a check icon or a word, never hue alone.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Success banner and status-pill ground; text on it is `success`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons: pending review, closing soon, few seats left. Always with an icon.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning banner and pill ground; text on it is `warning`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, rejected submissions. Always with an icon and a sentence that says how to fix it.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Error banner and inline field-error ground; text on it is `danger`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard/switch-access focus: a 2px ring offset 2px from the control, ≥3:1 on `chalk`, `surface` and `night`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind modal sheets and dialogs. Non-modal panels never use it.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Translucent material for the collapsed top bar and the guest Join dock, always with a 24px backdrop blur. Under reduced transparency it becomes `surface`.

styles.name: poster
styles.usage: Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold, uppercase, tight tracking. Profile names, pre-login statements, rank numerals on the podium. One per screen, and only where the screen has a single subject.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headlines at width 100. The emphasized words of a mixed-weight headline.

styles.name: display-light
styles.usage: The connective words of a mixed-weight headline, on the same line as `display`.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen titles in the large top bar.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number on a screen (total karma, rank). Tabular figures.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Stat trios, leaderboard ranks, counters. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Pick an Interest Group and your first task is waiting.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs, pre-login body, empty-state explanations.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Submit your repo link on Discord with the hashtag to earn karma.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body, list-row primary lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chip labels, field labels, metadata that needs weight.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and secondary metadata. Never below `ink-3`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kickers above titles and on tickets. Set the text in capitals in the string itself.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Task hashtags, muids (aysha@mulearn), campus codes, karma ledger amounts.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Ticket serials, tiny ledger tags, version strings.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Optical nudges only: icon-to-text baseline fixes, tab notch inset.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a chip between icon and label; avatar-stack overlap step.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; between a title and its metadata line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a rail or grid; list-row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (compact cards), sheet inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen gutter (left and right) on every screen; card inner padding (standard cards).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero slab inner padding; gap between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between related sections inside one topic.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between unrelated sections on a scrolling screen.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Breathing room above a poster headline; empty-state top offset.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Pre-login beat separation.

tokens.name: nav-clearance
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of scroll views on tab-root screens so the last row clears the floating navigation capsule (64 + 16 margin + 24 breathing).

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: The hashtag tab of a task card, checkboxes, ticket serial tags. Square-ish on purpose: these are labels stamped on things.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, search field, stat tiles, the date-strip day cells (as tall rounded stadiums), segmented-control track.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Standard cards, list groups, the ticket body.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Hero slabs, bottom-sheet top corners, the profile sheet over its poster.

tokens.name: radius-poster
tokens.usage: Full-bleed pre-login panels and the screen-sized color blocks of a poster moment.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter chips and status pills, avatars, icon buttons, the navigation capsule, progress tracks, the slide-to-confirm track, speech bubbles, live dots. Cards are never fully round.

size.note: Component dimensions in logical pixels (Flutter dp).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area of anything tappable, even when the visible mark is smaller.

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary button height.

tokens.name: button-h-sm
tokens.usage: Inline buttons inside cards (Join, Register); hit area still padded to 48.

tokens.name: field-h
tokens.usage: Text input and search field height.

tokens.name: icon-btn
tokens.usage: Circular icon button diameter (back, share, bell).

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Navigation capsule height.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in buttons, nav and rows.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips and metadata lines.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatar stacks and feed rows.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: List rows and leaderboard rows.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Own profile and public profile poster.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on tablets; centred with `chalk` either side.

shadow.note: Shadows mean 'this floats above the page'. Content cards never cast one.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Navigation capsule, toasts, the guest Join dock.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs, together with `scrim` when modal.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: An object the finger is holding (dragged sticker, a ticket being torn) and the tilted cards of pre-login beats.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and their labels.

tokens.name: opacity-press
tokens.usage: Ink overlay on pressed `surface` rows and cards (white overlay on `night`).

tokens.name: opacity-hatch
tokens.usage: Hatched fill for locked levels, future days and empty chart bars.

spring.note: Apple-style spring parameters: damping ratio and response (seconds). Flutter: SpringDescription.withDampingRatio(mass 1, stiffness (2π/response)², ratio).

tokens.name: spring-standard
tokens.usage: Default for every state change: nav selection, chip toggles, card expansion. No overshoot.

tokens.name: spring-snappy
tokens.usage: Press-in and release of buttons and cards (scale 0.97).

tokens.name: spring-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the profile sheet, released with the finger's velocity.

tokens.name: spring-momentum
tokens.usage: Only after a flick: thrown stickers in pre-login, swiped tickets, the slide-to-confirm snap-back.

tokens.name: spring-gentle
tokens.usage: Large surfaces entering: pre-login beat transitions, the karma count roll.
